systems.system: mass biometric enrolment solution for the national ID
systems.platform: Laxton enrolment kits (iris, face, fingerprint; work with or without connectivity) and software; database management system by IN Groupe
systems.owner: Government of Madagascar through the World Bank-funded PRODIGY project; Laxton commissioned to design, supply, deploy and support
systems.tiers: 2,500 kits; the January 2026 pilot enrolled nearly 130,000 people through 116 registration centres in 26 communes

note: Identity enrolment only; no civil registration system is described.
